name: faq-accordion
description: Expandable FAQ accordion with questions and answers using native HTML details/summary elements

ai.whenToUse: Use on pages that need an FAQ section — landing pages, pricing pages, product pages, or dedicated support pages. Best when you have 4-12 common questions to address.
ai.whenNotToUse: Don't use for long-form documentation or knowledge bases. Avoid when answers are very short (a simple list would work better).

subheadline.example: Everything you need to know to get started.

example.question: How do I get started?
example.answer: Install the CLI with npm, run the init command, and our AI will guide you through setup in under 2 minutes.

example.question: Can I use my own components?
example.answer: Absolutely. Blocks are standard Astro components. You can customize them or create your own from scratch.

example.question: Is there a free tier?
example.answer: Yes! The CLI and all blocks are free and open source. We offer paid plans for premium AI features and priority support.

example.question: What deployment targets are supported?
example.answer: We support Cloudflare Workers, Pages, and Vercel out of the box. Custom adapters can be added for other platforms.

example.question: How does i18n work?
example.answer: Content is organized by locale in content collections. Add a locale and the AI generates culturally appropriate content automatically.
